notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Evaluating Hosted API first to validate UX, then moving toward Dedicated if cost/unit and latency stable. POC focus on chat assistant for product teams + embeddings for semantic search.

POC metrics + findings: 
- Workload: interactive chat + background embedding indexing + reranking. 
- Traffic target (prod forecast): 50-120 QPS during burst windows; average 30 QPS. 
- Latency targets: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms. Current Hosted POC: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~380ms (spike variability with long contexts).
- Throughput observed: ~22 req/s during staged replay; token distribution skewed (median seq 64 tokens, tail to 1024).
- Caching: PV prefix/KV cache implementing reduced tokens per request; measured hit 45% for common templates; opportunity to reach 60% with prompt standardization.
- Batching: Engineering willing to accept micro-batching for background jobs (embeddings/rerank) but chat needs sub-200ms p50. Suggested batching window 20-80ms for hybrid.
- Quantization: Preference for nf4/int8 for 13B variants. SE recommended Redwood quantized variant -> estimated 40% inference cost reduction w/ minimal quality loss (A/B planned).
- Unit economics snapshot: Hosted API roughs at $0.10 - $0.14 per 1k gen tokens (including streaming overhead) based on POC traffic shape; Dedicated reserved commit projection estimates $0.028 - $0.045 per 1k tokens depending on commit level + caching/batching gains. Break-even projected ~3-5 months at 60% cache hit and conservative load.
- Routing/fallbacks: Want auto-fallback to smaller quantized model during overload and region-aware routing for EU customers.

Security & compliance: SSO/SAML required, audit logging + KMS for keys, retention controls for user data (30-90 days), initial ask for EU data residency for a portion of traffic. 

Quotes / voice of customer: "Cost is the gating factor — features are great but we need predictable unit economics and a migration path from Hosted to Dedicated." — Head of Platform.

Next workshop ask: 90-minute cost optimization session with Redwood SE + Optimize team to run concrete scenarios: batching windows, cache thresholds, quantization profile (nf4 vs int8), projected ARR impact and recommended commit tier. A/V + infra diagrams requested ahead of session.
